 02:20 GMT - Little change, as prices steadied at 1.2765 low to consolidate sharp losses from the 1.2872 high of last week. Bearish momentum from the latter suggest this giving way to renewed selling pressure later to retrace gains from the 1.2630 low of September. Nearby see strong support at 1.2750 congestion. Break here will see room for extension to support at the 1.2700/1.2680 area. Meanwhile, resistance remains at the 1.2800/25 congestion and 5th October high which is expected to cap and sustain losses from the 1.2872, 14 October high.
